settings.faq_content:
What payment methods do you accept?

We currently accept the following payment options:

  • PayPal (International)
  • GCash (Philippines)
  • Bank Transfer (Philippines)

📌 Note: All prices are displayed in PHP (₱) and USD ($). International orders will be automatically converted by your bank or PayPal.

👉 We do not accept direct credit or debit card payments at the moment.

Do I need to check my email after checkout?

Yes ✅ After you place your order, you’ll receive an email with payment instructions. Please follow the instructions to complete your payment.

🔔 Your order will only be secured once payment has been confirmed.

Is my payment information secure?

Yes! 🔒 All transactions are processed securely through PayPal, GCash, or your bank. We do not store or have access to your payment details.
settings.shipping_content:
🌍 Do You Ship Worldwide?

Yes! Our store is proudly based in the Philippines and we’re happy to ship our products across the globe.

✈️ International Shipping (via DHL)

  • Processing Time: 2–4 business days
  • Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive a confirmation email with your tracking number.
  • Delivery times vary depending on your country and customs process.
  • Customs & Import Fees: Customers are responsible for any customs duties, taxes, or import fees charged by their country.

🚚 Domestic Shipping (Philippines via J&T Express)

  • Processing Time: 2–3 business days
  • Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive a confirmation email with your tracking number.
  • Delivery usually takes 1–7 business days, depending on your location.

✅ Please note: Processing time does not include weekends or holidays. During sales or high-volume periods, order processing may take a little longer.
settings.terms_content:
We want you to love your order! 💜 If there are any issues, here’s our policy:

  • Returns & Exchanges are accepted within 2 days of receiving your order.
  • Items must be unused, unworn, and in their original packaging.
  • Shipping costs for returns/exchanges are the responsibility of the customer, unless the item arrived damaged or incorrect.

📧 To start a return or exchange, please contact us at wear.mujoco@gmail.com with your order number and reason for return.

⚠️ No Order Cancellations: Once your order has been shipped, we are unable to cancel it.

Once your return is received and inspected, we will notify you about your refund or exchange status.
settings.any_content:
How do I take care of my jewelry?

To keep your jewelry looking its best:

  • Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, and other chemicals.
  • Remove jewelry before swimming, exercising, or sleeping.
  • Store pieces in a dry place, ideally in the jewelry pouch/box provided.

Will my jewelry tarnish?

Our pieces are designed with high-quality materials. However, all plated jewelry may naturally tarnish over time depending on care, skin type, and exposure to moisture.

How do I clean my jewelry?

  • Gently wipe with a soft, dry cloth after each use.
  • Avoid using harsh cleaning solutions.
  • For stubborn spots, use a mild soap with water and pat dry immediately.
